text: Acordies col procedimientu, la cámara nueva escoyida en 2015 o 2016 va revisar otra vuelta HJR-3 pa siguir col procesu.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Ente los sos llogros, Vautier, aparte de dirixir, fizo una fuelga de fame en 1973 escontra lo qu'él consideraba censura política.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Cambió la llei francesa. El so activismu venía de cuando, con 15 años, se xuniera a la Resistencia Francesa na Segunda Guerra Mundial.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Recoyó la so vida nun llibru en 1998.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Nos años 1960 volvió a Arxelia, acabantes d'independizase, pa enseñar direición de cine.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: El yudoca xaponés Hitoshi Saito, dos veces medayista d'oru olímpicu, morrió a la edá de 54 años.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: La causa de la muerte foi un cáncer de conductos biliares intrahepáticu.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Morrió n'Osaka'l martes.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Amás d'ex-campeón olímpicu y mundial, Saito yera'l director del comité d'entrenamientu de la Federación Xaponesa de Yudu nel momentu de la so muerte.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Pelo menos 100 persones foron a la fiesta pa celebrar el primer aniversariu de la pareya, que se casara l'añu anterior.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Les autoridaes dixeron que se programó un actu formal d'aniversariu pa más alantre.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: La pareya casárase había un añu en Texas y viniera a Buffalo pa celebralo con amigos y familiares.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: L'home, de 30 años y nacíu en Buffalo, foi una de les cuatro víctimes del tirotéu, pero la so muyer nun tuvo daños.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ye un perconocíu y polémicu profesor d'inglés que punxo escuela en Modern Education y King's Glory y qu'afirmaba tener llograo'l númberu de 9.000 alumnos nel cumal de la so carrera.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Nes sos notes emplegaba pallabres que dellos padres y madres consideraben groseres, y acordies colos informes emplegó males pallabres en clas.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Modern Education acusólu de poner grandes anuncies nos autobuses ensin autorización y de mentir diciendo que yera'l tutor principal d'inglés.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Acusárenlu tamién de violación de derechos d'autor, pero nun tuvo cargos.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Un antiguu estudiante dixo que l’home “falaba en xíriga lunfarda nes clases, deprendía habilidaes pa usar nes cites y comportábase como si fuera collaciu de los estudiantes”.
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Nes últimes tres décades, magar qu'oficialmente sigue siendo un réxime comunista, China desendolcó una economía de mercáu.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Les primeres reformes económiques fixéronse baxo'l lideralgu de Deng Xiaoping.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Dende entós, el poder económicu de China multiplicó 90 vegaes el so valor.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Per primer vegada, China esportó más coches qu'Alemaña y superó a los EE.XX. como’l mayor mercáu de la industria.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: El PIB de China puede ser mayor que'l de los Estaos Xuníos en dos décades.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: La tormenta tropical Danielle, cuarta tormenta nomada de la temporada de furacanes de 2010, formóse nel este del océanu Atlánticu.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tormenta, que s'alcuentra aproximadamente a 3.000 milles de Miami, Florida, trai vientos sosteníos de 40 milles per hora (64 km/h)
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Los científicos nel Centru Nacional de Furacanes predicen que Danielle va garrar fuercia y convertise en furacán pal miércoles.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Tovía queda pa que la tormenta toque tierra y ye complicao calcular los daños potenciales nos Estaos Xuníos o nel Caribe.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Nacíu na capital de Croacia, Zagreb, Bobek fíxose famosu xugando pal Partizán de Belgráu.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Axuntóse a ellos en 1945 y quedó hasta 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Nel so tiempu col equipu, marcó 403 goles en 468 participaciones.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Naide xugó tantos partíos nin marcó más goles col equipu como Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: En 1995 votáronlu como meyor xugador de la historia del Partizán.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Les celebraciones entamaron con un espectáculu especial del perconocíu mundialmente Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Diose pasu darréu a les actuaciones de la Orquesta Sinfónica del Estáu d'Estambul, d'una banda militar otomana y de los cantantes Fatih Erkoç y Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Entós los baillarinos de Whirling Derviches xubieron al escenariu.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu actuó col tenor italianu Alessandro Safina y la cantante griega Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: P'acabar, el grupu de baille turcu Anatolia fixo l'espectáculu “Troya”.
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, un corredor de motos de 13 años, morrió tres de sufrir un accidente nel Circuitu d'Indianápolis.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Tando na vuelta de calentamientu, Lenz cayó de la moto y foi golpiáu pol so compañeru, Xavier Zayat.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: El personal médico de la pista atendiólu inmediatamente y tresportólu al hospital llocal, nel que morrió más tarde.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat nun sufrió firíes nel accidente.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: No que cinca a la situación financiera global, Zapatero añadió que “el sistema financieru ye parte de la economía, con una importancia vital.
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Tenemos una crisis financiera que yá dura un añu y que tuvo'l so peor momentu nos últimos dos meses. Pienso qu'agora los mercaos financieros van entamar a recuperar.”
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: La última selmana, Naked News anunció que diba aumentar les llingües internacionales pa informar sobre noticies, con trés tresmisiones nueves.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: La organización internacional, que yá informa n'inglés y xaponés, va sacar versiones n'español, italianu y coreanu de los sos programes pa televisón, web y dispositivos móviles.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Por suerte nun me pasó nada, pero vi escenes macabres al tratar la xente de romper les ventanes pa poder salir.
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Había xente golpiando los cristales con sielles, pero les ventanes yeren irrompibles.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Ún de los cristales rompió finalmente y entamaron a salir pela ventana”, dixo'l superviviente Franciszek Kowal.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Les estrelles dan lluz y calor pola enerxía que faen en meciéndose (o en fusionándose) los átomos d'hidróxenu colos d'otros elementos más pesaos.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Los investigadores tán trabayando pa crear un reactor que pueda producir enerxía de la mesma manera.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Esti, sicasí, ye un problema perdifícil de resolver y va llevar munchos años que veamos fechos reactores de fusión útiles.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L'aguya d'aceru flota sobre l'agua pola tensión superficial.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tensión superficial produzse porque les molécules na superficie de l'agua atráyense más unes a otres qu'a les molécules d'aire enriba d'elles.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Les molécules d'agua formen un pelleyu invisible na superficie del agua que permite que coses como una aguya puedan flotar enriba d'ello.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La cuchiella del patín modernu tien un filu doble con un güecu cóncavu en mediu. Los dos filos faen que s'agarre meyor al xelu, hasta cuando se vence pa un llau.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Por mor de que la parte baxa de la cuchiella ye curva, de la que la cuchiella s'inclina pa un llau o pa otru, el filu que ta en contautu col xelu cúrvase tamién.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Esto fai que'l patinador xire, si los patinos s'inclinen a la mandrecha, el patinador inclinaráse a la mandrecha, si lo faen a la esquierda, el patinador xira a la esquierda.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pa volver al so nivel d'enerxía previu, han de desfacese de la enerxía estra que sacaron de la lluz.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Esto faise emitiendo una partícula pequeña de lluz que se llama “fotón”.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Los científicos llamen esti procesu “emisión estimulada de radiación” porque los átomos estimúlense con lluz fuerte, que provoca la emisión d'un fotón de lluz, y la lluz ye un tipu de radiación.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: La siguiente ilustración amuesa cómo los átomos emiten fotones. Dende llueu, na realidá los fotones son muncho más pequeños que los del dibuxu.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: ¡Los fotones son tovía más pequeños que la materia de lo que tán fechos los átomos!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dempués de cientos d'hores d'usu, el filamentu acaba fundiendo y el focu dexa de funcionar.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: La bombilla precisa entós de sustitución. Ye preciso poner procuru a la hora de cambiala.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Primero hai qu'apagar la llámpara o desconeutala.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Esto ye porque la lletricidá del enchufe onde ta conectada la parte metálica de la bombilla puede pegate un bon calambre si toques l'enchufe o la parte metálica mientres tea enchufada parcialmente.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L’órganu más importante del aparatu circulatoriu ye'l corazón, que bombia'l sangre.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: El sangre sal del corazón per tubos que se llamen arteries y vuelve per otros de vuelta que se llamen venes. Los más finos y pequeños llámense capilares.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Los dientes d'un tricerátops podríen machacar non solo fueyes, tamién cañes fuertes y raigaños.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Dellos científicos piensen que los tricerátops comíen cícades, que yera un tipu de planta común del Cretácicu.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Estes plantes son como palmeres pequeñes con una copa de fueya afilao y con escayos.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Puede que los tricerátops usaren el so fuerte cuernu p’arrincar les fueyes primero de comer el tueru.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Otros científicos dicen qu'estes plantes son mui venenoses, poro, ye poco probable que les comiera nengún dinosauriu; anguaño los perezosos y otros animales como los loros (que descienden de los dinosaurios) pueden comer fueyes o frutos venenosos.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: ¿Cómo tiraría de min la gravedá d'Ío? Si tuvieres na superficie d'Ío pesaríes menos de lo que peses na Tierra.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Una persona que pese 200 llibres (90 k) na Tierra, pesaría unes 36 llibres (16 k) n'Ío. Asina que la gravedá, claro, tira menos de ti.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: El Sol nun tien una corteya como la Tierra na qu'andar. Ta enteru fechu de gas, fueu y plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: El gas faise más fino al allonxase del centru del Sol.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La parte esterior que vemos al mirar pal Sol llámase la fotoesfera, que lliteralmente quier dicir “esfera de lluz”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Unos tres años dempués, en 1610, l'astrónomu italianu Galileo Galilei usó un telescopiu pa observar que Venus tenía fases, mesmo que la Lluna.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Les fases prodúcense porque namás el llau de Venus (o de la Lluna) que da al Sol recibe lluz. Les fases de Venus sofiten la teoría de Copérnicu de que los planetes xiren alredor del Sol.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Entós, unos años depués en 1639, un astrónomu inglés llamáu Jeremiah Horrocks observó un tránsitu de Venus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Inglaterra vivió un llargu periodu de paz dempués de la reconquista de la Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Sicasí, en 991 Ethelred tuvo que s'enfrentar a una flota viquinga mayor que nenguna dende'l tiempu de Guthrum, d’un sieglu primero.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Esta flota lideróla Olaf Trygvasson, un noruegu que tenía l'oxetivu de lliberar el so país de la dominación danesa.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dempués de dellos reveses militares, Etelredu llogró un acuerdu con Olaf, que volvió pa Noruega col envís de reclamar el tronu, lo que fizo con ésitu desigual.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: L'alfabetu coreanu ye l'únicu diseñáu costafecha pal so usu popular y diariu. L'alfabetu inventóse nel 1444 nel reinu del rei Sejong (1418–1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong el grande foi'l cuartu rei de la dinastía Joseon y ye ún de los más almiraos.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Llamó orixinalmente al alfabetu Hangul alfabetu Hunminjeongeum, que significa “los soníos correutos pa la instrucción de la xente”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Hai bien de teoríes de cómo entamó'l sánscritu. Una d'elles ye sobre la emigración aria dende l'oeste hacia la India que llevó la so llingua con ellos.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: El sánscritu ye una llingua antigua que ye comparable al llatín faláu n'Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: El primer llibru del mundu conocíu ta escritu en sánscritu. Dempués de la recopilación de los upanishad, el sánscritu perdióse por razones de xerarquía.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: El sánscritu ye una llingua complexa y rica que sirvió de base pa munches llingües indies modernes, de la mesma manera que'l llatín ye la base de llingües europees como'l francés y l'español.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Acabada la guerra de Francia, Alemaña entamó a preparase pa invadir la islla de Gran Bretaña.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Alemaña punxo al ataque'l nome en clave de “Operación Lleón marín”. La mayoría de les armes y provisiones del exércitu británicu perdiérense na evacuación de Dunquerque, asina que los británicos taben mui febles.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Pero la Marina Real entá yera muncho más fuerte que la Marina Alemana (“Kriegsmarine”) y pudiera destrozar cualesquier flota invasora que se mandara pela Canal.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Sicasí, perpocos barcos de la Marina Real británica taben basaos cerca de les rutes probables de la invasión, al tarrecer los almirantes la posibilidá de que los fundieren los ataques aéreos alemanes.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Empecemos desplicando los planes d'Italia. Italia yera básicamente “l'hermanín” d'Alemaña y Xapón.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Teníen un exércitu y una armada más febles, anque acababen de facer cuatro barcos nuevos xusto enantes d'entamar la guerra.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: L'oxetivu principal d'Italia yeren los países africanos. Pa controlar esos países necesitaben una llanzadera pa que les tropes pudieren cruciar el Mediterraneu ya invadir África.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Con esti envís, tuvieron que se desfacer de les bases y barcos británicos n'Exiptu. Arriendes d'eses aiciones, los barcos de guerra italianos nun teníen que facer más nada.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: En cuantes a Xapón, esti yera un país-islla, igual que Gran Bretaña.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Los submarinos son barcos diseñaos pa viaxar baxo l'agua, y queden ehí una gran cantidá de tiempu.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Los submarinos usáronse na Primera y na Segunda Guerra Mundial. Daquella yeren mui lentos y teníen un rangu de disparu mui curtiu.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al principiu de la guerra desplazábense pela superficie marina, pero cuando los radares se desendolcaron y perfeicionaron, los submarinos tuvieron de somorguiase pa nun ser detectaos.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Los submarinos alemanes llamábense U-Boats. Los alemanes yeren bien amañosos pa navegar y manexar los sos submarinos.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Por mor del so éxitu colos submarinos, dempués de la guerra vese con desconfianza que los alemanes tengan munchos d’ellos.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: ¡Sí! El faraón Tutancamón, a vegaes llamáu “faraón Tut” o “el neñu faraón”, ye ún de los faraones del Antiguu Exiptu más conocios na edá moderna.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Ye interesante destacar que nun se consideraba mui importante na dómina antigua y nun se rexistraba na mayoría de les llistes de reis.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Sicasí, el descubrimientu d'esta tumba en 1922 fízolu famosu. Aunque munches tumbes antigües fueron robaes, esta tumba quedó práuticamente intauta.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Los más de los oxetos enterraos con Tutancamón caltiénense, incluyendo miles d'artefautos fechos con metales preciosos y piedres rares.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: La invención de les ruedes con radios fizo que los carros asirios fueren más llixeros, rápidos y tuvieren meyor preparaos pa dexar atrás a los soldaos y otros carros.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Les fleches de les mortales ballestes podíen afuracar l'armadura de los soldaos enemigos. Alredor del 1000 e.C. los asirios introduxeron la primer caballería.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: La caballería ye un exércitu que combate a caballu. La siella de montar entá nun s'inventara, asina que la caballería asiria combatía sobre'l llombu desnudu de los sos caballos.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Conocemos munchos políticos, científicos y artistes griegos. Probablemente, la persona más conocida d'esta cultura seya Homeru, el llexendariu poeta griegu, que compunxo dos obres maestres de la lliteratura griega: los poemes de la Iliada y la Odisea.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sófocles y Aristófanes siguen siendo dramaturgos populares y les sos obres tán consideraes ente les meyores de la lliteratura universal.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Otru griegu célebre ye'l matemáticu Pitágores, conocíu sobre too pol so teorema famosu sobre les rellaciones ente los llaos de los triángulos rectángulos.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hai distintos cálculos de cuánta xente fala hindi. Créese que ye ente la segunda y la cuarta llingua más falada del mundu.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: El númberu de falantes nativos cambia en función de si los dialeutos más averaos ente sí se tienen en cuenta.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Les estimaciones varien d'ente 340 millones a 500 millones de falantes, y hasta 800 millones de persones son quien a entendelu.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: L'hindi y l'urdu aseméyense nel vocabulariu pero non na escritura; los falantes de dambes llingües pueden entendese en conversaciones cotidianes.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Alredor del sieglu XV, el norte d'Estonia tenía muncha influyencia cultural alemana.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Dellos monxos alemanes queríen averar a Dios a la xente nativo, polo qu'inventaron l'idioma estoniu lliterariu.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Taba basáu nel alfabetu alemán y amestóse-y la grafía “Õ/õ”.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Col pasu del tiempu, converxeron munchos empréstamos del alemán. Esto marcó l'entamu de la ilustración.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Según la tradición, n’acabando los estudios l'heriede del tronu tien d’allistase nel exércitu.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Sicasí, Charles cursó estudios universitarios nel Trinity College de Cambridge, onde estudió antropoloxía y arqueoloxía y, más tarde, historia; graduóse nun 2:2 (una titulación menor de segunda clase).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlos foi'l primer miembru de la familia real británica n'algamar un títulu universitariu.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turquía europea (Tracia oriental o Rumelia na península balcánica) inclúi un 3% del país.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: El territoriu de Turquía tien más de 1.600 quilómetros (1.000 mi) de llargu y 800 km (500 mi) d'anchu, con una forma más o menos rectangular.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: La superficie de Turquía, incluyendo llagos, ocupa 783.562 quilómetros cuadraos (300.948 milles cuadraes), de los que 755.688 (291.773) tán n'Asia suroccidental y 23.764 (9.174) n'Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La superficie de Turquía fai que seya'l 37u país más grande del mundu; tien el tamañu combináu de Francia continental y del Reinu Xuníu.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turquía ta arrodiada de mar per tres partes: el mar Exéu pel oeste, el mar Prietu pel norte y el mar Mediterraneu pel sur.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxemburgu tien una llarga hestoria, pero la so independencia data de 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Parte del anguaño territoriu belxicanu formaba parte de Luxemburgu nel pasáu, pero pasó a ser belxicanu cola Revolución belxicana de 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxemburgu intentó siempre caltenese como un país neutral, pero ocupólu Alemaña tanto na Primer Guerra Mundial como na Segunda Guerra Mundial.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: En 1957 Luxemburgu convirtióse nun miembru fundador de la organización qu'anguaño se conoz como la Xunión Europea.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: La Drukgyal Dzong son una fortaleza en ruines y un monesteriu budista na parte alta del distritu de Paro (nel pueblu de Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dizse qu'en 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel creó'l fuerte pa conmemorar la so victoria escontra les fuercies tibetano-mongoles.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: En 1951 un fueu perdonó unes poques reliquies de Drukgyal Dzong, como la escultura de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dempués de la quema, la fortaleza conservóse y protexóse, calteniéndose como una de les atraiciones más fabuloses de Bután.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Nel sieglu XVIII Camboya viose encaxada ente dos vecinos poderosos, Tailandia y Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Los tailandeses invadieron Camboya delles veces nel sieglu XVIII y destruyeron Phnom Penh en 1772.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Nos años caberos del sieglu XVIII los vietnamites tamién invadieron Camboya.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: El dieciocho por cientu de los venezolanos tán nel paru y la mayoría de los que trabayen fáenlo na economía somorguiada.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dos tercios de los venezolanos activos trabayen nel sector servicios, cerca d'un cuartu na industria y un quintu na agricultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Una industria importante de Venezuela ye'l petroleu, de lo que'l país ye esportador netu, anque namás l'ún por cientu de la población trabaye na industria del petroleu.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Al entamu de la independencia del país, la esperiencia de los Xardinos Botánicos de Singapur ayudó a tresformar la islla nuna ciudá xardín tropical.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: En 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, un híbridu d'orquídea, escoyóse como la flor nacional de Singapur.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tolos años per ochobre, cerca de 1,5 millones d'herbívoros desplácense dende les llombes del norte escontra les llanures del sur, cruciando'l ríu Mara, a la busca de la lluvia.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Y, de vuelta al norte pel oeste, cruciando otra vegada pel ríu Mara, dempués de pasar les lluvies per abril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: La rexón del Serengueti tien dientro'l Parque Nacional del Serengueti, la Zona de Conservación de Ngorongoro y la Reserva Recreativa de Maswa, toes en Tanzania, y la Reserva Nacional del Masai Mara en Kenia.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Deprender a facer medios interactivos implica desendolcar tanto habilidaes convencionales y tradicionales como habilidaes deprendíes en clases interactives (escribir guiones, editar videu y audiu, falar, etc.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: El diseñu interactivu precisa de la re-evaluación de les nuestres idees asumíes no que cinca a la producción y qu'aprendamos a pensar de formes non lliniales.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: El diseñu interactivu requier que los componentes d'un proyeutu tean coneutaos ente ellos, pero qu'al empar tengan sentíu como una entidá separtada.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: El problema de les lentes de zoom ye que la complexidá focal y el númberu d'elementos de lente que faen falta p'algamar una riestra de llonxitúes focales son muncho mayores que pa los oxetivos fixos.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Esti problema tien menos incidencia porque los fabricantes de lentes tán meyorando los estándares na producción.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Esto permitió que les lentes d'aumentu ficieren semeyes d'una calidá comparable a la llograda por lentes con distancia focal fixa.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Otra desventaya de les lentes d'aumentu ye que l'apertura o velocidá máxima de la lente ye más baxa.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Esto fai difícil l'emplegar lentes de zoom barates en condiciones de poca lluz ensin un flax.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Ún de los problemes más comunes a la de convertir una película a DVD ye'l sobreescanéu.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Les más de les televisiones tán feches p'agradar al públicu xeneral.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Por eso tolo que ves na tele tien los bordes cortaos, los d'enriba, los d'abaxo y los de los llaos.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Esto faise p'asegurar que la imaxe cubra tola pantalla. Lo que se llama overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Desgraciadamente, cuando faes un DVD, lo más probable ye que los bordes tamién se corten y, si'l videu tien sotítulos demasiao cerca del borde, nun van vese dafechu.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: El castiellu tradicional medieval tien inspirao muncho la imaxinación, conxurando imáxenes de xustes, llacuaes y caballería artúrica.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hasta quedando metanes les ruines milenaries, ye fácil trayer a la mente'l soníu y los arumes de les vieyes batalles, y cuasi sentir el ruíu de los cascos nos adoquinos y goler el mieu xubiendo dende les mazmorres.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Pero, ¿ta la nuestra imaxinación basada na realidá? ¿Por qué razón se construyeron los castiellos? ¿Cómo se diseñaron y construyeron?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: El castiellu Kirby Muxloe, típicu d'esa dómina, ye más casa fortificada que castiellu dafechu.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Les sos ventanes grandes de cristal y paredes fines nun aguantaríen un ataque consistente per munchu tiempu.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Na década de 1480, cuando Lord Hastings entamara la so construcción, el país taba nuna paz relativa y la defensa nun yera necesaria más qu'escontra bandes pequeñes de lladrones.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L'equilibiru de poder yera un sistema nel que los países europeos buscaben caltener la soberanía nacional de tolos estaos del continente.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: La idea yera la de que toles naciones europees buscaren evitar que nenguna nación se ficiera poderosa y, poro, los gobiernos nacionales cambiaben davezu les sos aliances pa caltener l'equilibriu.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La Guerra de Socesión española foi la primer guerra na que'l tema central yera l'equilibriu de poder.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Esto supunxo un intercambiu importante, porque les potencies europees yá nun tendríen el pretestu del conflictu relixosu. Poro, la guerra de los Trenta Años foi la última guerra por cuestiones relixoses.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: El templu d'Ártemis n'Éfesu foi destruyíu'l 21 de xunetu del 356 e.C. nun fueu intencionáu d'Eróstratu.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Según la narración, la so motivación yera la fama a cualquier costu. Los efesios, ofendíos, anunciaron que'l nome d'Eróstratu nun diba ser mencionáu enxamás.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: L'historiador griegu Estrabón anotó dempués el nome, por eso sabemos d'ello anguaño. El templu destruyóse la mesma nueche na que nació Alexandru Magnu.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexandru, como rei, ofrecióse a pagar la reconstrucción, pero negáron-ylo. Dempués de morrer Alexandru, nel 323 e.C., foi reconstruyíu'l templu.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Asegúrate de que la to mano ta lo más relaxada posible mientres da bien les notes; evita tamién los movimientos estra de los deos.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: D'esta manera, vas cansar lo menos posible, recuerda que nun ye preciso golpiar les tecles con muncha fuercia pa consiguir más volume como pasa nel pianu.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Nel acordión, pa tener más volume, uses los fuelles con más presión o velocidá.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: El misticismu ye la busca de la comunión, la identidá o la consciencia d'una realidá última, una divinidá, una verdá espiritual o Dios.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: El creyente busca una esperiencia direuta, intuición, o visión de la realidá divina, de la deidá o les deidaes.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Los siguidores busquen ciertes formes de vida o práutiques qu'alimenten eses esperiencies.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: El misticismu diferénciase d'otres formes de creyencies relixoses y de cultu pol énfasis na esperiencia personal direuta d'un estáu únicu de conciencia, en particular de calter sele, esclarador, gayasperu o mesmo eufóricu.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: El sikhismu ye una relixón del socontinente indiu. Orixinóse na rexón de Panyab nel sieglu XV d'una dixebra sectaria dientro de la tradición hindú.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Los sikhs consideren que la so fe ye una relixón distinta al hinduismu anque reconozan los raigaños y vezos hindús.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Los sikhs llamen a la so relixón Gurmat, qu'en panyabí significa “el camín del gurú”. El gurú ye una figura fundamental en toles relixones indies, pero nel sikhismu ganó tanta importancia que ye'l pegoyu de les creyencies sikh.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La relixón fundóla nel sieglu XV el gurú Nanak (1469-1539). Siguiéronlu en socesión nueve gurús más.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Sicasí, en xunu de 1956, punxéronse a prueba les promeses de Krushchev al convertise los disturbios de Polonia, pente los que los trabayadores protestaben escontra la escasez de comida y los retayos salariales, nuna protesta xeneral frente al comunismu.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Anque a la fin Krushchev mandó los tanques pa restablecer l'orde, sí que cedió a dellos pidimientos y tuvo d'acuerdu en nomar al popular Wladyslaw Gomulka como primer ministru nuevu.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La civilización del valle del Indo yera una civilización de la edá del bronce nel noroeste del subcontinente indiu qu'incluyía la mayor parte del actual Paquistán y delles rexones del noroeste d'India y el noreste d'Afganistán.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La civilización espoxigó na cuenca del ríu Indu, d'onde vien el so nome.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Anque dellos estudiosos piensen que, al esistir la civilización tamién nes cuenques del ríu Sarasvati, güei secu, habría llamase civilización Indo-Sarasvati. Otros llámenla civilización Harapana, por Harappa, el primer xacimientu que s'escavó nos años venti.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La naturaleza militarista del imperiu romanu ayudó al desarrollu de los avances médicos.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: L'Emperador Augustu axuntó a los primeros médicos y formó'l primer Cuerpu Médicu Romanu pa usase depués de les batalles.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Los ciruxanos teníen conocimientu de dellos sedantes qu'incluyíen la morfina, d'estractos de la grana de l'amapola, y la escopolamina, de la grana del beleñu.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ficiéronse espertos n'amputar pa salvar los pacientes con gangrena, amás d'en face-yos torniquetes y pinces arteriales pa controlar el fluxu sanguineu.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: A lo llargo de munchos sieglos, l'Imperiu Romanu desendolcó grandes avances na melecina que llegaron hasta güei y que son la base de lo que sabemos.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: El Pureland ye una mena d'origami cola restricción de que nun se puede facer más qu'una doblez a cada vez, nun se permiten les dobladures más complexes como'l pliegu inversu y tolos pliegos tienen que tener asitiamientu claru.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Desarrollólu John Smith nos años 70 p'ayudar a los prauticantes ensin esperiencia o a los que teníen habilidaes motores llimitaes.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Los neños desendolquen un sentíu de raza y estereotipos raciales de bien mozos y esto afeuta'l so comportamientu.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Ye más, los neños de minoríes raciales col estereotipu de baxu rendimientu académicu tienden a nun rindir tan bien nes aules dempués de saber del estereotipu asociáu a la so raza.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ye'l tercer sitiu web más popular nos Estaos Xuníos d'América y tien a día de güei 54 millones de perfiles.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Estes páxines web llamaron muncho l'atención, especialmente nel ámbitu educativu.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Estos sitios web tienen aspectos positivos, ente los que tán la facilidá pa desarrollar una páxina de clase na que puedan incluise blogues, videos, semeyes y otros elementos.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Puede accedese fácil a esta páxina dando una web, que fai cenciello recordar y escribir a los estudiantes que tengan problemes col tecláu o cola ortografía.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Puede personalizase pa que seya fácil de lleer y que tenga tantos colores como queramos.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: El trestornu por déficit d'atención “ye un síndrome neurolóxicu y la definición clásica de los sos síntomes carauterísticos inclúi la impulsividá, la distraición, la hiperactividá y l'escesu d'enerxía”.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Nun ye una discapacidá intelectual sinón un trestornu del aprendizaxe; “afeuta a 3 de cada 5 neños, quiciabes llegue a los 2 millones nos EE.XX.”.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Los neños con TDA tienen problemes pa centrase nos deberes, pero pueden facelo con coses que-yos presten, como xugar, ver los dibuxos o escribir frases ensin puntuación.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Estos neños avecen a metese en munchos problemes porque “participen en comportamientos de riesgu, métense n'engarradielles y cuestionen l'autoridá” pa estimular el so cerebru, que nun se puede estimular con métodos normales.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: El TDA afeuta les rellaciones colos compañeros porque los otros neños nun pueden entender por qué faen lo que faen o por qué escriben como escriben, amás que'l so nivel de madurez ye estremáu.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Al cambiar l'habilidá p'algamar conocencia y p'aprender, de la manera que se menciona arriba, la tasa básica na que se llograba conocimientu cambiaba.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: El métodu pa consiguir información yera diferente. La presión dexó de tar na memoria individual, pero l'habilidá pa recordar testos pasó a ser un enfoque.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: N'esencia, el Renacimientu cambió de forma significativa l'enfoque del aprendizaxe y la divulgación del conocimientu.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Al contrario qu'otros primates, los homínidos nun usen les manes pa movese, cargar pesu o ximelgase pelos árboles.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Les manes y los pies de los chimpancés aseméyense en tamañu y llonxitú, si bien la mano carga'l pesu nos nudiellos al andar.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La mano humana ye más curtia que'l pie, con falanxes más reutes.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Los fósiles de manes de dos a tres millones d'antigüedá revelen esti cambiu na especialización de la mano de la llocomoción a la manipulación.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Delles persones piensen qu'esperimentar de forma artificial munchos suaños llúcidos mui davezu pue ser cansao.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La principal razón d'esti fenómenu ye'l resultáu de los suaños llúcidos, ampliando la duración del tiempu ente los estaos REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Con menos REMs per nueche, esti estáu nel que s'esperimenta suañu real y el cuerpu se recupera vuélvese infrecuente como pa ser un problema.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Esto ye tan cansao como si te llevantares cada venti o trenta minutos y mirares la televisión.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: L'efectu depende de la frecuencia per nueche na que'l to cerebru trate de suañar de forma llúcida.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Les coses nun-yos fueron bien a los italianos nel norte d'África cuasi dende l'entamu. A la selmana de que declararen la guerra, el 10 de xunu de 1940, el 11er escuadrón d'húsares británicu sitió'l Forte Capuzzo en Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Nuna emboscada al este de Bardia, los británicos capturaron al inxenieru xefe del décimu exércitu, el xeneral Lastucci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: El 28 de xunu, Marshal Italo Balbo, el gobernador xeneral de Libia y supuestu socesor de Mussolini, foi asesináu por fueu amigu mientres aterrizaba en Tobruc.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: La esgrima deportiva xuégase en munches categoríes, dende l'aficionada d'estudiantes universitarios hasta la competición profesional y olímpica.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: El deporte xuégase en formatu de duelu, un tirador escontra otru.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: El golf ye un xuegu nel que los xugadores usen palos pa meter pelotes en furacos.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Xuégase a dieciocho furacos nun percorríu normal, onde los xugadores entamen nel primer furacu del percorríu y acaben nel decimoctavu.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: El xugador que precisa de menos golpes, o golpes del palu, pa completar el percorríu gana.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: El partíu xuégase en prau, la yerba alredor del furacu córtase más y llámase green.
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Quiciabes el tipu de turismu más común ye'l que la xente asocia a viaxar: El turismu recreativu.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Esto ye cuando la xente va a un sitiu que ye mui distintu de la so vida cotidiana pa relaxase y esfrutar.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Les sableres, los parques temáticos y los cámpines son los llugares a los qu'avecen dir los turistes d'ociu.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Cuando l'oxetivu de la nuestra visita a un sitiu concretu ye conocer la so historia y cultura, esti tipu de turismu conozse como turismu cultural.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Los turistes pueden visitar dellos llugares señalaos d'un país concretu o pueden optar por centrase namás nuna área concreta.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Los colonizadores, en vistes de l'actividá, tamién pidieren refuerzos.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Ente les tropes que reforzaron les posiciones del frente ta'l 1er y 3er reximientos de New Hampshire con 200 homes, baxo'l mandu del Coronel John Stark y James Reed (dambos convirtiéronse depués en xenerales).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Los homes de Stark posicionáronse a lo llargo de la valla nel estremu norte de la posición qu'ocupaben los colonos.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Al baxar la marea y abrise un güecu a lo llargo del ríu Mystic na parte noreste de la península, allargaron la valla con un muru baxu de piedra en direición norte, acabándolu na oriella del agua nuna playa pequeña.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Bien Gridley bien Stark punxeron un poste d'unos 100 pies (30 m) delantre de la valla y mandaron que nun se disparara hasta que lu pasaren los soldaos regulares.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: El plan americanu taba fiáu a llanzar ataques coordinaos dende tres posiciones diferentes.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: El xeneral John Cadwalder llanzó un ataque de distracción escontra la guarnición británica en Bordentown, pa cortar cualquier refuerzu.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: El Xeneral James Ewing diba cruciar con 700 milicianos el ríu en Trenton Ferry, tomar la ponte sobre Assunpink Creek y evitar que les tropes enemigues escaparen.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La principal fuercia d'asaltu, formada por 2.400 soldaos, diba cruciar el ríu nueve milles al norte de Trenton, y dividise dempués en dos grupos, unu baxo'l mandu de Greene y l'otru baxo'l de Sullivan, col envís de llanzar un ataque primero de qu'alboreciere.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Col cambéu del cuartu de milla pa la media milla, la velocidá faise muncho menos importante y la resistencia ye primordial.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Dende llueu qu'un corredor de primera, que cuerre media milla en menos de dos segundos, ye daquién rápidu, pero tien que desendolcar resistencia.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Correr pel campu pel iviernu, amás de dir al ximnasiu pa fortalecer la parte cimera del cuerpu, ye la meyor preparación pa la temporada de carreres.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Les pautes nutricionales apropiaes nun garanticen un rindimientu d'élite, pero pueden afeutar la salú xeneral de los deportistes mozos.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Caltener l'equilibriu enerxéticu, hidratase bien y entender los distintos aspeutos de la suplementación puede contribuyir a la meyora del so rindimientu y aumentar el disfrute de la práctica deportiva.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Correr medies distancies ye un deporte relativamente baratu; sicasí, hai muncha confusión no que cinca a la poca equipación que fai falta pa ello.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Pueden comprase los productos según se tenga necesidá, pero la mayoría van tener pocu o nengún impactu nel rindimientu.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Los atletes pueden querer más un productu anque nun-yos dea beneficios reales.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L'átomu puede considerase unu de los cimientos fundamentales de cualquier materia.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ye una entidá percomplexa, que consiste, acordies col modelu de Bohr simplificáu, nun nucleu orbitáu por electrones, en ciertu mou asemeyáu a los planetes qu'orbiten el sol – ver Figura 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: El nucleu ta formáu por dos partícules: protones y neutrones.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Los protones tienen una carga llétrica positiva y los neutrones nun tienen carga. Los electrones tienen una carga llétrica negativa.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pa ver a la víctima, primero has comprobar la escena p'asegurate de la to seguridá.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Tienes que te fixar na posición de la víctima cuando t'allegues y ver cualesquier señal d'alerta automática.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si te manques intentando ayudar, puede que lo único que faigas seya empeoralo too.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: L'estudiu mostró que la depresión, la llercia y el pensamientu catastróficu mediaben na rellación ente dolor y incapacidá en persones con dolor llombar.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Namái los efeutos del pensamientu catastróficu, non de la depresión o de la llercia, yeren condicionantes pa les sesiones selmanales de PA.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Los que participaben n'actividaes regulares precisaben de más sofitu en términos de perceición negativa del dolor, estremando ente dolor crónicu y la sensación de malestar del movimientu físicu normal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La vista, o l'habilidá de ver, depende de múerganos sensores del sistema visual o güeyos.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Hai munches construcciones de güeyos diferentes, que varien na so complexidá dependiendo de les necesidaes del organismu.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Les diferentes construcciones tienen capacidaes diferentes, son sensibles a diferentes frecuencies d'onda y tienen distintos graos d'agudeza. Amás, necesiten distintos procesamientos pa comprender la entrada y distintos númberos pa funcionar de forma óptima.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Una población ye'l conxuntu d'organismos d'una especie particular nuna área xeográfica dada.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Cuando tolos individuos d'una población son idénticos en rellación a un fenotipu particular, conócense como monomórficos.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Cuando los suxetos muestren delles variantes d'un fenotipu son polimórficos.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Tamién les colonies de formigues guerreres caminen y añeren en distintes fases.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Na fase nómada los exércitos de formigues faen marches de nueche y paren p'acampar de día.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colonia entama una fase nómada cuando la comida disponible disminuye. Nesta fase, la colonia fai ñeros temporales que cambien cada día.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Caúna d'estes marches o desfiles dura aproximadamente 17 díes.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: ¿Qué ye una célula? La pallabra célula vien de la pallabra llatina “cella” que quier dicir “cuartu pequeñu” y usóla per primer vez un investigador qu'estudiaba la estructura del corchu.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La célula ye la unidá básica de toles coses vivientes, y tolos organismos tán compuestos d'una o más célules.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: En realidá, les célules son tan básiques y importantes pal estudiu de la vida, que les llamen davezu los “lladriyos de la vida”.
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: El sistema nerviosu caltién la homeostasis mandando impulsos nerviosos per tol cuerpu pa caltener el fluxu del sangre bien y ensin problemes.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Estos impulsos nerviosos pueden mandase tan rápido al traviés del cuerpu qu'ayuden a caltenelu seguru énte cualquier amenaza potencial.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Los tornaos afeuten una zona más pequeña en comparanza con otres tormentes fuertes, pero destrúin too al so pasu.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Los tornaos arranquen árboles, estrocen edificios y llancen coches pel aire. El dos por cientu de los tornaos más violentos duren más de tres hores.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Estes tormentes monstruoses tienen vientos d'hasta 380 km/h (133 m/s, 300 mph)
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Los seres humanos lleven miles y miles d'años faciendo y usando lentes p'aumentar el tamañu.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Sicasí, los primeros telescopios de verdá fixéronse n'Europa a últimos del sieglu XVI.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Estos telescopios usen una combinación de dos lentes pa facer que los oxetos llonxanos paezan más cercanos y más grandes al empar.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: La envidia y l'egoísmu formen parte de nosotros mesmos y ye cola cooperación cuando hai beneficios pa la mayoría. Siempre va ganase más a curtiu plazu si se ye arrogante.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Por fortuna, la mayoría de la xente decátase de que la meyor opción a llargu plazu ye trabayar a comuña con otros.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Munches persones suañen col día en que los humanos puedan dir a otra estrella y esplorar otros mundos. Dellos entrúguense qué hai ehí fuera, hailos que creyen qu'hai alieníxenes o otres vides n'otros planetes.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Con too, si esto pasara, probablemente nun duraría munchu tiempu. Les estrelles tán tan repartíes qu'hai trillones de milles ente estrelles que son “vecines”.
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Igual un día los tos bisnietos lleguen a un planeta con vida alieníxena y s'entruguen polos sos oríxenes.
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Los animales tán fechos de munches célules. Comen coses y dixérenles dientro. Los más de los animales pueden movese.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Namás los animales tienen cerebru (anque nun lu tengan tolos animales; les aguamales, por exemplu, nun tienen).
