eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Los animales atópense per tola Tierra. Furen na tierra, naden nos océanos y vuelen nel cielu.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: La célula ye la unidá estructural y funcional más pequeña de los organismos.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: "Célula vien de la pallabra llatina cella, que quier dicir ""cuartu pequeñu""."
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si observa dalgún ser vivu col microscopiu, va ver que tán fechos de cuadradinos o pelotines.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, biólogu inglés, vio cuadrinos pequeños nel corchu con un microscopiu.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Son como cuartos. Foi la primer persona en ver les célules muertes.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Los elementos y compuestos pueden pasar d'un estáu a otru ensin camudar.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: El nitróxenu n'estáu gaseosu tien les mesmes propiedaes que'l nitróxenu líquido. L'estáu líquidu ye más densu pero les molécules son idéntiques.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L'agua ye otru exemplu. El compuestu d'agua ta formáu por dos átomos d'hidróxenu y ún d'osíxenu.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Tien la mesma estructura molecular n'estáu gaseosu, líquidu o sólidu.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Anque'l so estáu físicu pueda cambiar, el so estáu químicu caltiénse.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: El tiempu ye daqué que mos arrodia y afeuta tolo que facemos. Sicasí, ye difícil d'entender.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: El tiempu lleva miles d'años siendo analizáu por estudiosos relixosos, filosóficos y científicos.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Esperimentamos el tiempu como una serie d'eventos qu'abarquen el futuru, el presente y el pasáu.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: El tiempu ye tamién la manera na que comparamos la duración de los socesos.
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Puede observar el pasu del tiempu usté mesmu al esaminar la repetición d'un fenómenu cíclicu. Un fenómenu cíclicu ye daqué que pasa una vez y otra de manera regular.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Anguaño los ordenadores úsense pa manipuliar semeyes y videos.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Les animaciones sofisticaes pueden facese n'ordenadores, y esti tipu d'animaciones úsase cada vez más en películes y televisión.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La música suel grabase usando ordenadores sofisticaos pa procesar y amestar los soníos.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Na mayor parte de los sieglos XIX y XX pensábase que los maorís fueran los primeros habitantes de Nueva Zelanda; cazaben moes o páxaros xigantes.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teoría entós estableció la idea de que'l pueblu maorí emigró dende Polinesia nuna gran flota y aportó a Nueva Zelanda dende los Moriori, afitando una sociedá agrícola.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Sicasí, pruebes nueves suxeren que los Moriori yeren un grupu de maorís del continente qu'emigraron dende Nueva Zelanda a les Islles Chatham, desendolcando la so propia cultura pacífica.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Tamién hubo otra tribu nes islles Chatham d'orixe maorí qu'emigrara de Nueva Zelanda.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Llamábense Moriori a sigo mesmos, hubo delles amarraces y al final desaniciáronlos.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Xente que tuvo implicao delles décades ayudónos a apreciar les nueses fortaleces y dedicación, faciendo por evaluar tamién dende la sinceridá los fracasos.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Al escuchar a xente compartir les sos histories individuales, familiares y organizatives, consiguimos una visión valiosa del pasáu y de delles de les personalidaes qu'influyeron, pa bien o pa mal, na cultura de la organización.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Anque conocer la propia historia nun implica comprender la so cultura, fai que la xente tenga conciencia d'en qué parte de la organización tán.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Mientres comprueben l'ésitu y se decaten de los fallos, los individuos y toles persones que participen descubren meyor los valores, misiones y lo que mueve a la organización.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: D'esta manera, recordar exemplos previos de comportamientu entamador y los ésitos resultantes, ayudaron a la xente a tar abierto a cambeos nuevos y orientaciones pa la ilesia llocal.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Estes hestories d'ésitu amenorgaron el mieu al cambéu, creando inclinaciones positives al cambéu nel futuru.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Los patrones de pensamientu converxente son téuniques de resolución de problemes qu'axunten idees estremaes o campos p'atopar una solución.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L'oxetivu d'esta postura ye la velocidá, la lóxica y la precisión, amás d'identificar fechos, reaplicar téuniques esistentes y atropar información.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Lo más importante d'esta mentalidá ye que namái hai una respuesta posible. Sólo pienses en dos respuestes, ello ye, correuta o incorreuta.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Esti tipu de pensamientu ta asociáu con ciertos procedimientos, científicos o normales.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Les persones con esti tipu d'intelixencia tienen un pensamientu lóxicu, pueden alcordase de patrones, resolver problemes y trabayar n'estudios científicos.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Los humanos son, con muncho, la especie con más talentu a la hora de lleer les mentes de los demás.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Eso quier dicir que somos quien a predicir con ésitu lo que perciben, preparen, creyen, saben o deseen otros humanos.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Ente eses habilidaes, comprender la intención de los demás ye perimportante. Permítenos resolver posibles ambigüedaes de les aiciones físiques.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Por exemplu, si ves a daquién intentando frañir la ventana d'un coche, polo xeneral vas asumir que ta intentando roba-y el coche a daquién.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Tendríen que lu xulgar d'un mou distintu de perder les llaves y de ser el so propiu coche al qu'intentaba entrar.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: La IRM básase nun fenómenu físicu nomáu resonancia magnética nuclear (RMN), que descubriere en 1930 Felix Bloch (que trabayaba na Universidá de Stanford) y Edward Purcell (de la Universidá de Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Nesta resonancia los campos magnéticos y les ondes de radio faen que los atómos emitan señales de radio minúscules.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Nel añu 1970, Raymond Damadian, un médicu y investigador científicu, fizo'l descubrimientu de la imaxe de resonancia magnética como ferramienta pal diagnósticu médicu.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Cuatro años más tarde dióse-y una patente, que foi la primera patente emitida nel campu de la RMI.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: En 1977, el Dr. Damadian completó la construcción del primer escáner MRI de “cuerpu-enteru”, al que nomó “Indomitable”.
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicación asincrónica fomenta'l tiempu pa la reflexón y la reaición énte los demás.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Permite a los estudiantes trabayar al so ritmu y controlar el fluxu d'información instructiva.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Amás, hai poques restricciones horaries cola posibilidá de facer xornaes flexibles. (Bremer, 1998).
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L'usu del internet y de la World Wide Web permite a los escolinos tener accesu a tola información en cualquier momentu.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: L'alumnáu tamién puede unviar entrugues a los sos instructores a cualquier hora del día y esperar que se-yos conteste razonablemente llueu, en cuenta d'esperar hasta'l siguiente alcuentru presencial.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L'enfoque posmodernu del deprendimientu ufierta la llibertá de los absolutos. Nun hai una única manera bona de deprender.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: De fechu, nun hai una cosa sola bona d'aprender. L'aprendizaxe ocurre na esperiencia ente l'aprendiz y el conocimientu que se-y presenta.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: La nuestra esperiencia actual, con toos estos programes de do-it-yourself o que se basen na presentación d'información o l'aprendizaxe, ilustra esti aspectu.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Munchos de nós vémonos mirando pa un programa de televisión que mos cuenta un procesu o una esperiencia de la que nun vamos participar o aplicar el conocimientu.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Nunca nun vamos arreglar un coche, facer una fonte nel patiu de casa, viaxar a Perú pa esaminar ruines antigües, o reformar la casa del vecín.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Gracies a los enllaces submarinos de cable de fibra óptico y al internet per satélite, Groenlandia ta bien conectada y el 93% de la población tien accesu a internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: El to hotel o los tos anfitriones (si quedes nuna pensión o casa privada) quiciabes tenga wifi o un ordenador conectáu a Internet, y toles llocalidaes cuenten con un cibercafé o espacios públicos con wifi.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Como se mencionara enantes, anque la pallabra “eskimo” sigue aceptándose nos Estaos Xuníos, considérase peyorativa por muncha xente del Árticu non estauxunidense, especialmente de Canadá.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Anque quiciabes oyas usar la pallabra a los nativos groenlandeses, los estranxeros han evitar el so usu.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Los habitantes nativos de Groenlandia llámense a sigo mesmos Inuit en Canadá y Kalaalleg (plural Kalaallit), esto ye, groenlandés, en Groenlandia.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: En Groenlandia desconozse virtualmente'l crime o'l mal tratu hacia los estranxeros. Nin siquiera nes ciudaes, nun hai “zones difíciles”.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: El fríu ye quiciabes l'únicu peligru real que van atopar los que nun tean preparaos.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Si visites Groenlandia nes estaciones fríes (teniendo en cuenta que cuando más escontra'l norte se va, más frío va facer) ye perimportante trayer ropa de bastante abrigu.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Los díes perllargos del branu pueden llevar a problemes de nun dormir abondo y a otres consecuencies de salú venceyaes.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Nel branu, tate atentu a los mosquitos nórdicos. Anque nun tresmiten enfermedaes pueden ser mui molestos.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Anque la economía de San Francisco enllaza col turismu, tamién diversifica.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Los sectores más importantes del emplegu son los servicios profesionales, el públicu, les finances, el comerciu y el turismu.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Como sal davezu na música, el cine, la lliteratura y la cultura popular, la ciudá y los sos referentes conócense per tol mundu.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco desendolcó una infraestructura turística importante con munchos hoteles, restoranes y centros de convenciones de primera categoría.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco tamién ye ún de los meyores sitios del país pa probar otres gastronomíes asiátiques: coreana, tailandesa, india y xaponesa.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Viaxar a Walt Disney World ye un pelegrinaxe mayor pa munches families americanes.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: La visita “típica” implica volar al Aeropuertu Internacional d'Orlando, garrar un autocar hasta'l llugar, agospiase nun hotel Disney, pasar una selmana ensin salir del parque y colar.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Hai infinites variaciones posibles, pero esto sigue siendo lo que la mayoría de la xente quier dicir cuando fala de “dir a Disney World”.
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Munches de les entraes que se vienden en sitios web de puyes como eBay o Craiglist son entraes de dellos díes Park-Hopper usaes parcialmente.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Anque ye una actividá percomún, Disney tórgala: los billetes nun son tresferibles.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: P'acampar per debaxo del borde nel Gran Cañón fai falta un permisu d'acampada na naturaleza.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Los permisos tán llendaos pa protexer el cañón, y tán disponibles a partir del primer día del mes, cuatro meses primero del mes d'entamu.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: D'esti mou, un permisu de movilidá pa cualquier fecha en mayu va tar disponible dende'l primeru de xineru.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Les zones más conocíes, como'l Bright Angel Campground, a la vera de Phantom Ranch, llénense de solicitúes na primer fecha qu'abren pa reserves, polo xeneral.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Hai un númberu llendáu de permisos d'accesu disponibles n'orde de pidimientu.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Entrar a Sudáfrica en coche ye una forma impresionante d'esfrutar de tola guapura de la rexón, asina como de ver sitios que nun suelen tar nes rutes turístiques normales.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Esto pue facese nun coche normal con una planificación afayadiza, pero encamiéntase muncho l'usu d'un 4x4; y ye que, a munchos llugares namás pue llegase nun 4x4 de ruedes grandes.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ten en cuenta cuando faigas planes que, anque Sudáfrica ye estable, dellos de los países vecinos non.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Los requisitos y el preciu de los visaos cambien d'un país a otru y dependen tamién del país del que se venga.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Cada país tien tamién lleis úniques qu'afiten qué ferramientes d'emerxencies han tar nel coche.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ye un pueblu na parte occidental de Zimbabue, al otru llau de la frontera dende Livingstone, Zambia, y cerca de Botsuana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La ciudá queda xusto al pie de les catarates, que son l'atracción principal, anque esti destín turísticu ufre oportunidaes abondes pa una estancia más llarga, tanto pa los aventureros como pa los turistes.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Na temporada de lluvies (de payares a marzu), la cantidá d'agua va ser mayor y les catarates van ser más impresionantes.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: De xuru que vas moyate si cruces la ponte o andes peles siendes qu'arrodien les catarates.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Per otru llau, ye xusto pol volume tan altu d'agua que pueden tapecese les vistes de les catarates, ¡pol agua!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: La tumba de Tutancamón (KV62). La KV62 bien puede ser la tumba más famosa de les del valle, l'escenariu del descubrimientu fechu por Howard Carter en 1922 del cuasique intactu enterramientu del xoven rei.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: En comparanza coles otres tumbes reales, la tumba de Tutancamón nun paga tanto la pena visitala, pos ye más pequeña y con poca decoración.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Cualquier persona que quiera ver amueses de los daños, fechos a la momia nel intentu de sacala del caxón, va deceicionase: namái la cabeza y los costazos queden a la vista.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: La riqueza fabulosa de la tumba yá nun ta nella, sinón que se llevó pal Muséu Exipcianu d'El Cairu.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Los visitantes col tiempu xustu habríen dir ayuri.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km al sudoeste de Siem Reap. Esti templu foi construyíu nel cumal a finales del sieglu IX, nel reináu del rei Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L'ambiente solombriegu del templu y les vistes del llagu Tonle Sap faen que la xubida al monte pague la pena.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Puede combinase la visita al xacimientu con un viaxe en barcu escontra'l llagu.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Fai falta un pase Angkor pa entrar nel templu, asina que nun escaezas el pasaporte cuando vayas pa Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Xerusalén ye la capital y la ciudá más grande d'Israel, anque la mayoría de países y les Naciones Xuníes nun la reconocen como capital.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: L'antigua ciudá nos cerros de Xudea tien una historia perinteresante de miles d'años.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: La ciudá ye sagrada pa tres relixones monoteístes – el xudaísmu, el cristianismu y l'islam, y funciona como un centru espiritual, relixosu y cultural.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Por mor de la importancia relixosa de la ciudá, sobre manera de los munchos xacimientos de la zona de la Ciudá Vieya, Xerusalén ye ún de los principales destinos turísticos d'Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Xerusalén tien munchos xacimientos arqueolóxicos y culturales, arriendes de centros culturales, cafeteríes y restaurantes concurríos y dinámicos.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador esixe a los ciudadanos cubanos recibir una carta d'invitación primero de dexalos entrar nel país pelos aeropuertos internacionales o los puntos d'almisión fronteriza.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Esta carta ha ser llegalizada pol Ministru d'Asuntos Esteriores ecuatorianu y ha cumplir dellos requisitos.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Estos requisitos tán diseñaos p'apurrir un fluxu migratoriu organizáu ente dambos países.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Los ciudadanos cubanos que tienen una tarxeta verde americana han visitar el consuláu ecuatorianu pa consiguir una esceición a esti requerimientu.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: El to pasaporte tien que tener una validez de más de 6 meses dempués de les tos feches de viaxe. Necesites un billete de vuelta p'amosar cuánto vas quedar.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Les visites son más barates pa grupos grandes, asina que si vas solu o con un únicu amigu, intenta topar otra xente pa facer grupu de cuatro o seis y meyorar el preciu por persona.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Sicasí, esto nun tendría por qué esmolecete, porque davezu los turistes anden espardíos pa llenar los coches.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: En realidá paez que ye una manera d'engañar a la xente faciéndo-yos creyer qu'han pagar más.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Imponente sobre la cara norte de Machu Pichu ta esti monte emprunu, davezu l'escenariu de munches semeyes de les ruines.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Velo dende abaxo da daqué medrana; ye una xubida pindia y complicada, pero la mayoría de la xente, si ta nuna forma física razonable, habría ser quien a xubir nunos 45 minutos.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Colóquense pasos de piedra a lo llargo de la mayor parte del camín, y nes seiciones más pindies los cables dan apoyu a les manes.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dicho eso, ye probable que quedes ensin aldu; tate sollerte nes partes pindies, sobre manera si tán llentes, porque pueden ser peligroses.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Hai una pequeña cueva cerca del cumal que tien que s'atravesar. Ye mui baxa y bastante estrecha.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: La meyor manera de ver los llugares y la fauna de les Galápagos ye en barcu, igual que lo fizo Charles Darwin en 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Más de 60 cruceros naveguen pel agua de les Galápagos, con una capacidá d'ente 8 y 100 pasaxeros.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La mayoría de la xente fai la so reserva con munchu anticipu (al tar los barcos enllenos davezu na temporada alta).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Asegúrate de que l'axente col que reserves seya un especialista nes Galápagos y tenga conocencia de distintos tipos de barcu.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Esto va valir p'asegurase de que los tos intereses particulares o restricciones van acompasase col barcu más afayadizu pa ellos.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Enantes de la llegada de los españoles nel sieglu XVI, el norte de Chile yera parte del Imperiu incaicu mientres que los indíxenes araucanos (o mapuches) vivíen nel centru y el sur de Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Los mapuches fueron tamién ún de los últimos grupos indíxenes independientes que nun tuvieron baxo dominiu castellanofalante hasta la independencia de Chile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Magar que Chile declaró la so independencia en 1810 (metanes les guerres Napoleóniques que dexaron España ensin gobiernu central funcional per un par d'años) la victoria decisiva sobre los españoles nun se llogró hasta 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La República Dominicana ye un país caribeñu qu'ocupa la metá este de la islla de La Española, que comparte con Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Amás de les playes de sable blanco y de los paisaxes de monte, el país tien el primer asentamientu européu nes Amériques, anguaño parte de Santu Domingu.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Los taínos y caribes fueron los primeros en poblar la islla. Los caribes yeren un pueblu arawakofalante qu'aportó alredor del 10.000 e.C.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Pocos años dempués de la llegada de los esploradores europeos, la población de taínos menguara muncho polos conquistadores españoles.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Según Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratáu de les Indies) ente 1492 y 1498 los conquistadores españoles mataron alredor de 100.000 taínos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Esti espaciu construyóse como adriu d'un conventu nel sieglu XVII, del que namái queda'l Templu de San Diego.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Anguaño funciona como una plaza central, y siempre tien cantidá de coses nella, pel día y pela nueche.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Hai numberosos restaurantes alredor del xardín y de tarde fáense conciertos de baldre na carpa central.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejón del Beso (Caleyón del Besu). Dos balcones separtaos por namás 69 centímetros ye'l llar d'una vieya lleenda d'amor.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Por unos pocos céntimos los neños contaránte la hestoria.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: La Islla Bowen ye un destín popular pa una escursión d'un día o d'una fin de selmana qu’ufierta canoes, rutes, tiendes, restoranes y más coses.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Esta comunidá auténtica asítiase en Howe Sound xusto a les afueres de Vancouver, y llégase a ella fácil con taxis acuáticos programaos que salen de la islla de Granville nel centru de Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Pa los qu'esfruten de les actividaes al aire llibre, ye preciso una ruta pel corredor del Sea to Sky.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 hores de conducción dende Vancouver) ye caro pero famoso polos Xuegos Olímpicos de 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Pel iviernu, esfruta del meyor esquí de Norteamérica, y pel branu anímate col ciclismu de monte.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ye preciso acutar permisos con antelación. Has tener un permisu pa pasar la nueche en Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ye l’únicu puestu de guardamontes qu'ufre agospiamientu y comida además de campin. La Leona, San Pedrillo y Los Patos ufren campin, pero nun hai servicios de restauración.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Ye posible acutar los permisos d'accesu al parque dende la Estación de guardaparques en Puerto Jiménez, pero nun acepten tarxetes de creitu.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: El Serviciu del Parque (MINAE) nun emite permisos del parque con más d'un mes d'antelación primero de la llegada.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ufierta un serviciu de reserves por una tarifa de 30 US$, ó 10$ pa pases d'un día; otros detalles, na páxina del Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Les islles Cook son un archipiélagu, asitiáu na Polinesia, na metá del pacíficu sur, que ta en llibre asociación con Nueva Zelanda.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ye un archipiélagu de 15 islles repartíes per 2,2 millones de km2 d'océanu.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Tando nel mesmu fusu horariu que Ḥawai, les islles considérense delles veces “l'Australia de Ḥawai”.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Anque más pequeñu, a los visitantes más vieyos recuérda-yos Ḥawai primero de ser un estáu ensin tolos hoteles grandes pa turistes y otros desarrollos.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Les Islles Cook nun tienen nenguna ciudá pero tán compuestes por 15 islles estremaes. Les principales son Rarotonga y Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Anguaño, nos países desendolcaos, dar cames y almuerzos de lluxu convirtióse nun ciertu tipu d'arte.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Al final, los B&B compiten, sobre manera, en dos coses principales: cames y almuerzos.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Acordies con esto, nos meyores d'estos establecimientos unu puede topar la meyor ropa de cama, mesmo una colcha fecha a mano o una cama d'época.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: L'almuerzu puede incluyir delicies de temporada de la rexón o la especialidá de la casa.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: L'establecimientu puede ser un antiguu edificiu históricu con muebles vieyos, xardinos curiaos y piscina.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Metete nel to propiu coche y entamar un viaxe llargu per carretera tien un atractivu intrínsecu na so simplicidá.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: En cuenta de vehículos más grandes, ye fácil que yá teas familiarizáu con guiar el to coche y conozas les sos llendes.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Montar una tienda nun terrenu priváu o nuna ciudá puede atrayer fácil atención inesperada.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: En poques pallabres, usar el coche ye una manera perbona de facer un viaxe per carretera pero non, nello mesmo, una manera de “facer acampada”.
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: El campin en vehículu ye posible si tienes una furgoneta llarga, SUV, Sedán o camioneta con asientos que se puedan echar p'atrás.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Dellos hoteles tienen patrimoniu de la edá d'oru del ferrocarril de vapor y los tresatlánticos, ello ye, de primero de la segunda guerra mundial, nel sieglu XIX o primera parte del XX.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Nestos hoteles quedábense, cenaben y facíen vida nocherniega los ricos y famosos.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: La decoración antigua, la falta d'instalaciones modernes y ciertu calter avieyáu formen parte de la so personalidá.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Avecen ser propiedaes privaes pero a vegaes agospien a xefes d'estáu y otros mandatarios.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viaxeru con munchu dineru podría permitise un billete d'avión de vuelta al mundu, parando bien de vegaes pa quedar nestos hoteles.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Una rede d'intercambiu d'hospitalidá ye una organización que xune viaxeros con xente llariego nes ciudaes que van visitar.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Polo xeneral, p'axuntase a una rede d'esti tipu namás ye preciso rellenar un formulariu online; anque delles redes ufierten o piden otres comprobaciones.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Entós dase una llista d'agospios disponibles, en papel o en llinia, a vegaes con recomendaciones y opiniones d'otros viaxeros.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing fundóse en xineru del 2004 dempués de que'l programador Casey Fenton atopara un vuelu baratu a Islandia pero nun tuviera ónde se quedar.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Mandó correos electrónicos a dellos estudiantes de la universidá llocal y recibió un númberu espampanante d'ufiertes d'agospiu gratuitu.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Los hostales acueyen davezu a xente mozo (el güéspede típicu tien venti y picu d’años) pero tamién puedes topar con viaxeros mayores.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Les families con guaḥes son difíciles de ver, pero dellos hostales almítenles en cuartos privaos.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La ciudá de Beixín en China va ser la ciudá organizadora de los Xuegos Olímpicos d'Iviernu de 2022, polo que va ser la primer ciudá n'organizar los Xuegos Olímpicos d'iviernu y branu.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beixín va agospiar les ceremonies d'apertura y pieslle y les competiciones de xelu en pista cubierta.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Les otres competiciones d'esquí van facese na estación de Taizicheng en Zhangjiakou, a unos 220 km (140 milles) de Beixín.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Los más de los templos tienen un festival añal qu'entama a últimos de payares y acaba a metá de mayu, y cambia en función del calendariu añal de cada templu.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La mayoría de los festivales del templu celébrense como parte del aniversariu del templu o del cumpleaños de la deidá que lu presida o cualquier otru socesu asociáu col templu.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Los festivales de los templos de Kerala son perinteresantes, con procesiones regulares d'elefantes adornaos, orquestes del templu y otres celebraciones.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Una World's Fair (llamada davezu Esposición Universal o Espo a seques) ye un gran festival internacional de les artes y les ciencies.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Los países participantes presenten esposiciones artístiques y educatives en pabellones p'amosar al mundu problemes mundiales o la historia y la cultura del país.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Les International Horticultural Exposition son eventos especializaos n'arreglu floral, xardinos botánicos y tolo rellacionao coles plantes.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Anque en teoría son añales (mientres se faigan en distintos países), na práctica non.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Estos socesos duren polo xeneral ente tres y seis meses, y desendólquense en llugares de non menos de 50 hectárees.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Hai dellos formatos de película distintos que s'emplegaron a lo llargo de los años. La película estándar de 35 mm (36 x 24 mm negativu) ye muncho más común.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Polo xeneral, puede reponese con facilidá si s'escosa, y da una resolución comparable a un DSLR actual.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Delles cámares de videu de formatu mediu graben en 6 por 6 cm, con un negativu de 56 por 56 mm exautos.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Esto da una resolución cuatro veces mayor que la d'un negativu de 35 mm (3136 mm² contra 864)
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: La fotografía de fauna y flora ye ún de los mayores retos pa un fotógrafu; ye una combinación de suerte, paciencia, esperiencia y bon equipu.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: La fotografía de naturaleza dase por sentada, pero como na fotografía en xeneral, una imaxe val más que mil pallabres.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: La fotografía de fauna y flora requier d'un teleoxetivu llargu, anque delles coses como les bandaes de páxaros o les creatures menudes necesiten d'otros tipos.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Munchos animales estraños son difíciles de topar; los parques a vegaes tienen normes pa les semeyes con fines comerciales.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Los animales xabaces pueden ser espantinos o agresivos. El mediu ambiente puede ser fríu, caldiu o hostil.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Nel mundu hai más de 5.000 llingües estremaes, incluyíes les más de venti con alredor de 50 millones de falantes.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Lo que ta escrito ye davezu más fácil d'entender que lo que se fala. Esto vese perbién nes direiciones, que son davezu difíciles de pronunciar.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Munches naciones enteres falen un inglés fluyíu dafechu y n'otres puedes esperar que sepan daqué – sobre manera la xente mozo.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imaxina, por casu, ún de Manchester, ún de Boston, un xamaicanu y ún de Sydney sentaos nuna mesa cenando nun restorán de Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Tán faciéndose esfrutar los unos a los otros con hestories de les sos ciudaes natales, contaes nos sos acentos distintos y nes xírigues llocales.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Comprar la comida nos supermercaos ye la manera más barata de comer. Si nun se tien la posibilidá de cocinar, la escoyeta ta llendada a los productos yá preparaos.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Los supermercaos tán consiguiendo cada vuelta una mayor variedá de comida precocinao. Hailos que tienen un fornu microondes o otros medios de calentalo.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: En dellos países o tipos de tiendes tienen, pelo menos, un restorán, davezu ún bastante informal y con bonos precios.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fai copies de la póliza y de los datos del asegurador y trailes contigo.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Necesiten poner el corréu electrónicu y los númberos de teléfonu internacionales del asegurador pa pidir conseyos o autorización y poner reclamaciones.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Ten otra copia nel equipaxe y en llinia (mándate un corréu electrónicu con un axuntu, o guárdalu na “nube”).
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Si viaxes con un ordenador portátil o tableta, guarda una copia na so memoria o discu (que puedas ver ensin internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Además da-yos copies de la póliza y los datos a los tos acompañantes y parientes o amigos que queden y tean dispuestos a ayudar.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Los alces (tamién conocíos como uapitís) nun son agresivos de por sí, pero pueden defendese si noten una amenaza.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Al nun ver la xente a los alces como animales potencialmente peligrosos, pueden arimase demasiao y ponese en riesgu.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Consumi bebíes alcohóliques con moderación. L'alcohol afeuta a tol mundu ensin distinción, y conocer la to llende ye perimportante.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Les afeiciones derivaes del alcoholismu, a llargu plazu, inclúin daños nel fégadu y mesmo la ceguera y la muerte. El dañu potencial ye mayor col consumu d'alcohol de destilación non regulada.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: El llicor illegal puede contener delles impureces peligroses, ente les que ta'l metanol, que puede causar ceguera o la muerte mesmo en dosis pequeñes.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Les gafes pueden ser más barates n'otros países, n'especial en países d'ingresos baxos onde'l costu del trabayu ye menor.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Piensa en facer un esame de la vista nel to país, sobre manera si lo cubre'l seguru, y lleva la receta pa presentala en cualesquier otru llugar.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Les montures de marques d'altu nivel en zones como estes pueden tener dos problemes: delles pueden ser falses y les verdaderes, importaes, seique seyan más cares que nel to país.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: El café ye ún de los bienes más comerciales, puedes topalo de munchos tipos na to rexón.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Sicasí, hai munches formes diferentes de tomar café pel mundu que paga la pena probar.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Facer barranquismu ye metese hasta'l fondu d'un cañón o barrancu, que puede tar secu o llenu d'agua.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: El barranquismu amiesta elementos de la natación, la escalada y el saltu – pero nun fai falta tanta preparación pa entamar (comparao a la escalada, el bucéu o l'esquí alpín, por exemplu)
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Facer senderismu ye una actividá al aire llibre que consiste en caminar per entornos naturales, davezu en pistes de senderismu.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: L'escursionismu diurnu implica distancies de menos d'una milla hasta distancies que pueden cubrise nun mesmu día.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pa una caminata d'un día per una sienda fácil fai falta poca preparación, y cualquier persona que tea más o menos en forma puede facela.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Les families con neños pequeños van precisar más coses, pero un día d'escursión ye cenciello d'algamar hasta con nácaros y demás reciella.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A nivel internacional, hai alredor de 200 empreses qu'organicen rutes y carreres. La mayoría trabaya de manera independiente.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: El socesor de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours, ta en contautu con docenes d'organizadores de rutes con vistes nos cuatro continentes.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Con aniciu na barcelonina Running Tours Barcelona y na danesa Running Copenhagen, xuntáronse-yos aína Running Tours Prague en Praga y otres.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Hai munches coses a tener en cuenta enantes de viaxar ayuri.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Cuando viaxes nun esperes que les coses seyan “como en casa”. La educación, les lleis, la comida, el tráficu, l'agospiamientu, los estándares, la llingua y demás, van cambiar, en graos distintos, con respeuto al llugar nel que vives.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Esto ye daqué que siempres has tener en cuenta pa evitar la deceición o seique hasta'l disgustu pa cola manera de facer les coses propia del llugar.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Les axencies de viaxes esisten dende'l sieglu XIX. Una axencia ye davezu una bona opción pa facer un viaxe per zones que tean más allá de la esperiencia del viaxeru no que cinca a la naturaleza, la cultura, la llingua o los países probes.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Anque les más de les axencies tán dispuestes a aceutar la mayoría de les reserves ordinaries, munchos axentes especialícense en tipos especiales de viaxes, presupuestos o destinos.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Ye meyor dir a un axente que xestione davezu viaxes asemeyaos a los de to.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Mira pa lo qu'ufre l'axencia, bien nun sitiu web o nun escaparate.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Si nagües por ver el mundu a baxu preciu, por necesidá, mou de vida o desafíu, hai delles maneres de facelo.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Básicamente queden en dos categoríes: O trabayar mientres viaxes, o intentar llendar los gastos. Esti artículu céntrase no último.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Aquellos que quieran sacrificar comodidá, tiempu y predictibilidá p'amenorgar los gastos hasta cerca de cero, han mirar viaxe con presupuestu mínimu.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: El contratu da por fecho que los viaxeros nun van robar, allanar, participar del mercáu prietu, pidir o d'otra manera aprovechase d'otres persones pal so porgüeyu.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Un puestu de control d'inmigración ye polo xeneral la primera parada de la que desembarcamos d'un avión, un barcu o otru vehículu.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: En dellos trenes tresfronterizos faen inspeiciones nel tren en marcha y debe tener un documentu d'identidá válidu cuando xuba nún d'esos trenes.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: En trenes cama, el revisor puede recoyer los pasaportes pa que tu nun tengas qu'espertar.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Rexistrase ye otru requisitu pal procesu de visaos. En dellos países, has rexistrar la to presencia y les señes del agospiu nel que quedes énte les autoridaes llocales.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Esto puede implicar tener que rellenar formularios cola policía llocal o tener que dir a les oficines d'inmigración.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: En munchos países con lleis d’esta mena, los hoteles llocales van tar al cargu del rexistru (asegúrate d'entrugar)
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: N'otros casos, namái necesiten rexistrase los que nun queden n'instalaciones turístiques. Sicasí, esto fai que la llei seya más complicada, asina qu'averígualo con tiempu.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L'arquitectura trata'l diseñu y la construcción d'edificios. L'arquitectura d'un llugar ye davezu un atractivu turísticu per se.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Munchos edificios son guapos de ver y les vistes dende un edificiu altu o dende una ventana bien posicionada pueden ser dignes d'almiración.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L'arquitectura solápase en gran manera con otres disciplines, ente les que tán la planificación urbana, la inxeniería civil, les artes decoratives, el diseñu d'interiores y el diseñu paisaxísticu.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Como munchos de los pueblos son mui remotos, faise difícil atopar munchu ociu nocherniegu ensin dir a Albuquerque o Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Sicasí, cásique tolos casinos que se mencionen arriba sirven bébora alcohólico y dellos traen espectáculos renomaos (sobre too los más grandes, nes afueres d'Albuquerque y Santa Fe)
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Repara: los chigres de pueblu nun son siempre llugares afayadizos pa los visitantes d'otros estaos.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Esto débese a que'l norte de Nuevu Méxicu tien problemes significativos cola conducción baxo los efeutos del alcohol y la concentración de conductores ebrios ye alta nes cercaníes de los bares de pueblu.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Los murales indeseaos o espintarraquios conócense como grafitis.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Anque nun ye daqué nuevo, muncha xente quier rellacionalo col vandalismu de la mocedá en propiedá pública y privada con espráis de pintura.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Sicasí, anguaño hai grafiteros reconocíos, eventos grafiteros y muries acutaes. Los grafitis, nesti contestu, paecen más obres d'arte que non firmes imposibles.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: El llanzamientu de bumerán ye daqué popular que quieren probar munchos turistes.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Si quies deprender a llanzar un bumerán que vuelva a la to mano, asegúrate primero de tener ún que pueda volver.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: La mayoría de los bumeranes qu'hai n'Australia nun vuelven. Ye meyor que los principantes nun traten de llanzalos si tira l’aire.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: La comida Hangi cocínase nun furacu caliente nel suelu.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: El furacu cáldiase con piedres calentaes nun fueu, o en dellos llugares con calor xeotérmicu que fai que delles zones del suelu tean calientes de mou natural.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: El ḥangi úsase davezu pa facer un asáu tradicional pa la cena.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Delles places en Rotorua ufierten hangi xeotérmiques, mientres qu'otres hangi pueden vese en Christchurch, Wellington y ayuri.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail tien dos clases de trenes de cercaníes en y alredor de Ciudá del Cabu; MetroPlus (llámase tamién Primera Clas) y Metro (llámase Tercera Clas)
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ye más afayadizu y ta menos atarriquitáu pero ye daqué más caro, anque sigue siendo más barato que los billetes de metro normales n'Europa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Cada tren tien vagones MetroPlus y vagones Metro; los vagones MetroPlus tán siempre al final del tren, más cerca de Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Llevando pa otros – Nun dexes nunca'l to equipax fuera de la vista, sobre manera cuando tas cruciando fronteres internacionales.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Podríes vete utilizáu como tresportista de droga ensin sabelo, lo que te diba trayer munchos problemes.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Esto incluye ponese en fila, ya que pueden usase los perros antidroga en cualesquier momentu ensin avisu previu.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Dellos países tienen castigos perdraconianos inclusive cuando nun hai reincidencia; pueden incluyir penes de cárcel d'hasta 10 años o la muerte.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Les maletes desatendíes son un oxetivu pa los robos y tamién puen atrayer l'atención de les autoridaes sollertes a les amenaces de bomba.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Nel país d'orixe, por mor de la esposición constante a xérmenes llocales, les posibilidaes son bien altes de que yá teas inmune a ellos.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Pero n'otres partes del mundu, onde la fauna bacteriolóxico ye nuevo pa ti, tienes munches más posibilidaes de tener problemes.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Amás, nos climes cálidos les bacteries medren más rápido y sobreviven más tiempu fuera del cuerpu.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: "Asina tenemos los andancios de ""l'estómagu de Delhi"", ""la maldición del faraón"", ""la venganza de Montezuma"", y munches otres variantes."
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Como colos problemes respiratorios nos climes un poco más fríos, los problemes intestinales en climes cálidos son abondo comunes y na mayoría de casos son molestos pero non peligrosos.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Si viaxes a un país desarrolláu per primera vegada (n'otra parte del mundu) ten presente'l posible shock cultural.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Munchos viaxeros veteranos y esperimentaos fueron superaos pola novedá del turismu en zones en desarrollu, onde toles diferencies culturales s'acumulen rápido.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Los primeros díes piensa n'invertir n'hoteles, comida y servicios d'estilu y calidá occidentales p'avezate meyor.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Nun duermas nun colchón o nuna colchoneta en suelu en zones nes que nun conozas la fauna llocal.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Si vas acampar, lleva una cama plegable o una hamaca pa nun tar cerca de culiebres, escorpiones y otres coses.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Llena la casa de café cargao pela mañana y de dalgo de mazaniella relaxante de nueche.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Cuando quedes en casa de vacaciones, tienes tiempu pa tratate bien y dedicar unos minutos de más a cocinar dalgo especial.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Si vos llama l'aventurera, nun dexéis pasar la oportunidá de facer dalgunos zumos de frutes.
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Seique descubras una bébora cenciella que puedas facer p'almorzar cuando tornes a les tos rutines diaries.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Si vives nuna ciudá con una cultura de bebida variao, ve a chigres o pubs en barrios pelos que nun sueles dir.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: "Pa los que nun tean familiarizaos cola xíriga médica, les pallabres ""infeiciosu"" y ""contaxosu"" tienen significaos distintos."
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Una enfermedá infeiciosa ye aquella que ta causada por un patóxenu como un virus, una bacteria, un fungu o otros parásitos.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Una enfermedá infeiciosa ye la que se tresmite namái con tar cerca d'una persona infestada.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Munchos gobiernos soliciten que los viaxeros qu'entren, o los ciudadanos que salgan del país se vacunen d'una riestra d'enfermedaes.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Estos requisitos pueden depender de qué países visitó o tien intención de visitar un viaxeru.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Ún de los puntos fuertes de Charlotte, Carolina del Norte, ye que tien una gran bayura d'opciones de muncha calidá pa les families.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Los residentes d'otres arees tienen principalmente motivaciones familiares o d'amistá pa mudase; poro, los visitantes topen una ciudá que pueden disfrutar cola reciella.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Nos últimos 20 años, el númberu d'opciones pa neños na zona de viviendes de Charlotte medró esponencialmente.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Les families nun avecen garrar taxis en Charlotte, pero pueden ser útiles en delles circunstancies.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Hai un suplementu por ser más de dos pasaxeros, polo qu'esta opción puede ser más cara de lo necesario.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L'Antártida ye'l llugar más fríu del planeta y arrodia'l Polu Sur.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Les visites turístiques son cares, requieren tar bien de forma física, solo se pueden facer en branu, de payares a febreru, y tán llendaes a la Península, les islles y el mar de Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Unos dos mil emplegaos viven equí pel branu nunes cincuenta bases que tán na so mayoría naquelles zones; un númberu pequeñu queda pel iviernu.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L'interior de l'Antártida ye una meseta erma cubierta d'ente 2 y 3 km de xelu.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Dacuando fáense escursiones aérees al interior, pa dir de monte o pa llegar al Polu, que tien una base grande.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
